## Requirements (contract)

1. Wiring: `CONNECTOR_FOR_SOURCE` entries + `accountability_vocab.toml` `[sources]` entries +
   reviewed `live_targets.toml` rows + committed fixtures; shadow-replay diff = 0. Entity-ref
   claims for the oversight subject where P31.5's identity rule resolves it; text-only otherwise.
2. Hosted land per source: Cloud Run `sig-ingest-<id>` jobs running
   `sig-ops scheduled-ingest --source <id> --sink pg`, SHA-tagged image deployed by pinned
   digest (never `:latest`), restricted-bucket capture store mounted. Record the `ops/runs`
   row + `ingest_run_completion` + landed claims; re-run +0. Create ONLY the new jobs.
3. Rights: `sig-db rights-decisions --decisions docs/build/reports/rights/p293_dispositions.json
   --apply` — append-only `rights_decision` rows; confirmed licence resolves onto landed claims.
4. Deepen: `materialize.sh --apply run resolution` + `accountability` (+ `camera-sites` if
   relevant); per-source derived/linked counts; re-run +0.
5. Cadence: `ops/cadence.toml` `[[sources]]` rows (job + scheduler) per yielding source;
   `sig-ops cadence --check` green.
6. Per-source reports under `docs/build/reports/p31.12-hosted/`; honest outcomes for
   non-yielding sources, never fabricated.

## Acceptance criteria

- AC1: 4 `CONNECTOR_FOR_SOURCE` entries + targets + fixtures; shadow diff 0 (deterministic).
- AC2: hosted per-source land: fetch record + claims (or honest recorded outcome); re-run +0 (live).
- AC3: rights decisions applied append-only; resolution + accountability re-run with
  per-source counts; re-run +0 (live).
- AC4: cadence rows; D-R7.3-BREADTH annotated 4/8 while OPEN; `make check` green.

## Plan

- **`accountability.py`** gains a targeted `oversight_report` target kind (the §22.6-E
  pattern, not a new connector): `discover` resolves each `kind = "oversight_report"`
  target to its reviewed `live_targets` row by URL and refuses anything else
  (enumeration shapes → `CrawlAttempted`; a capture whose URL has no reviewed row →
  `ContentDrift`, fail closed). `parse` extracts the capture's text (`html_text` for
  pages, `pdf_text_pages` for PDFs) and requires every reviewed `literals` string to
  survive in it — a missing literal is `ContentDrift`, never a claim asserted beyond
  the capture (the P25.8 live-clause precedent). `extract`/`normalize` emit ONE
  `AccountabilityEventRecord` per report from the reviewed row (external_id,
  event_type, epistemic_status, event_date, organizations, technologies,
  affected_party_class) + a `primary_record`-class `EvidenceLink`; `claim_rows()`
  produces the rows and the existing `link()` (`partner_ref_rows`,
  `event_organizations` ∈ `_PARTNER_PREDICATES`) appends entity-ref twins — the
  audited agency / program resolves as a `partner:name` organisation under ADR-112
  where `partner_identity` accepts the name, text-only otherwise.
- **Vocab** `accountability_vocab.toml`: `vocab_version` → `2026.09.26.1`; four
  `[sources]` entries; a reviewed `[oversight_report]` block (the source-class default
  + the reviewed-row contract).
- **`runner.py`**: four `CONNECTOR_FOR_SOURCE` → `"accountability"` entries.
- **`live_targets.toml`**: reviewed `oversight_report` rows — GAO product landing pages
  (GAO-21-518, GAO-23-105607); DHS OIG report PDFs (OIG_09-12, OIG-17-49); the DHS
  fusion-center annual-assessment PDFs (2016, 2021); the GOV.UK SCC report landing
  pages (2021-2022, 2023-2024). Two per source.
- **Fixtures** `tests/connectors/fixtures/accountability/`: committed capture bytes —
  real pages/PDF first-pages for OIG/fusion/gov.uk; for GAO, `gao.gov`'s NetScaler
  refuses all automated egress from this network (403 `x-n: S`), so the fixture is the
  archived Wayback capture of the same URL — provenance recorded in `SOURCES.md`.
- **`ops/cadence.toml`**: monthly `[[sources]]` rows (oversight reports republish
  rarely) — landed as day-14/15/16/17 at 06:09 UTC (distinct days, distinct from
  every existing row).

> **As landed (corrects the plan above):** ONE reviewed target per source (the
> ticket requires reviewed `live_targets` rows — four rows total, one verified
> document each, not the draft's two-per-source sweep); fixtures under
> `tests/connectors/fixtures/oversight_reports/` (new dir, with `SOURCES.md`);
> PDF fixtures are deterministic `minimal_pdf` captures carrying the verbatim
> cover text (the ~3MB/1.2MB upstream PDFs are not committed — the CCOPS
> convention); HTML fixtures are trimmed verbatim excerpts.
- **Hosted**: `export.sh`-style `git archive` → Cloud Build → `sig-api:ingest-<sha>`;
  four new `sig-ingest-*` jobs deployed on the pinned digest (capture-store volume,
  `SIG_CLOUDSQL_INSTANCE`, `SIG_PG_*` env, `sig-pg-password` secret) + `sig-sched-*`
  triggers; execute + read the `ops/runs` rows + `ingest_run_completion`; +0 re-run;
  `rights-decisions --apply` over cloud-sql-proxy (`PGPASSWORD` env only — never the
  laptop recipe's literal DSN/password on a command line); `materialize.sh --apply run
  resolution` + `accountability`; +0 re-run.
